source.snapshot_semantics: Working-tree contents captured before the delivery commit. head is the base Git commit; dirty status describes capture time, not later delivery status. File hashes identify the validated content.

real_subprocess_kill.control: SIGKILL sent to the runtime CLI process group
SIGKILL sent to the runtime CLI process group

resume_followups.heldout_status_oracle: Original unknown oracle retained; four unsatisfied action/evidence predicates independently adjudicated as defensible, not a proven production failure.

implemented_improvements: Structured unittest TestResult channel replaces text-count parsing.
Factual evidence collector with scoped candidate identity, owner history, declared provenance, stable capture and validated persistence.
Dependency restoration distinguished from user-directed stop authority.
Behavior uncertainty distinguished from known unmet action or record obligations.
Precise probe semantics and adequately covered clean controls.
limitations: Bounded screening; no aggregate reliability estimate.
Same inherited model settings; no cross-model or Linux execution study.
Fixed structured criteria in packet probes do not measure unconstrained prompt-to-contract extraction.
Static discovery and reviewer arms measure review/plan choices, not edit churn.
Workflow execution hosts used explicit self-review; independent artifact review was retrospective.
Alternate owner fixture is synthetic, not installed ShipLoop integration.
Commit-before-notes was a controlled host handoff; the separate runtime test used a real OS process-group kill.
Collector observes artifact hashes but reviewer identity, check return code and check-to-candidate association are host-declared.
Same-privilege hostile Python tests are outside the structured launcher isolation claim.
No model or token cost telemetry was available.

documentation_updates: Explicit scope, history and commit defaults
Worked three-review convergence and commit-message example
Read-only preview input and expanded interpretation
Final verification counts and historical checkpoint labels
delivery_followup.independent_documentation_review: Previous findings resolved; reviewer-requested 83-event wording clarified as combined across all five scenarios per interpreter.
delivery_followup.publication: Local commit and push requested; no Git remote was configured at capture time.
